title: Offset blind spots in compressed language models: a black-box audit and a two-grid remedy (code and data)
description: Code, derived data tables and scripts that rebuild every table and figure of the paper 'Offset blind spots in compressed language models: a black-box audit and a two-grid remedy' from the derived tables. Code is licensed under Apache-2.0; the data tables, expected values and figures are licensed under CC BY 4.0 (see LICENSE-DATA). Raw API outputs, benchmark texts, model weights and the registration files are not included (see README).
